title: Card Editor Form / Modal
description: A form (inline or modal) to create and edit a card's title, description, and labels, with validation and cancel/save actions.
spec:
1. Open the editor to create a new card in a column
2. Open the editor to edit an existing card, pre-filled with its values
3. Validate that title is required before save is allowed
4. Support adding/removing labels in the editor
5. Cancel discards changes; save commits to the store
6. Verify focus management and that Escape/cancel closes the editor
